gold_sql:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.390157 33.734073)',4326)::geography, 4500)
    AND p.leisure = 'park'
),
poi_elev AS (
  SELECT c.id, elev.z
  FROM candidates c
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, c.geometry::geometry) AS z
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, c.geometry::geometry)
    LIMIT 1
  ) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM poi_elev
WHERE z <= 100;

WITH georgia_nature_center AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-83.390157, 33.734073), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(geom, 4500) AS geom
  FROM georgia_nature_center
),
parks_in_buffer AS (
  SELECT p.id
  FROM parks p, buffered_area b
  WHERE ST_Intersects(p.geometry, b.geom)
),
parks_with_elevation AS (
  SELECT p.id
  FROM parks_in_buffer p
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT (ST_Value(r.rast, p.geometry::geometry)).val AS elevation
    FROM public.dem_us r
    WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  ) r ON TRUE
  WHERE elevation < 100
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS park_count
FROM parks_with_elevation;
